players_description: One database includes you and other players you frequently play with. Form play groups for combined profiles.
players_you_help: Read your UID aloud to a friend so they can add you as a guest in a campaign they record. When they share that campaign back to you, your entry resolves to your current name and portrait automatically.
players_others_help: Other players are people you record on behalf of (e.g. family at your table). They get their own UID and their own campaign history inside your database.
players_groups_help: Play groups bundle several players together so you can view a shared profile across everyone's campaigns. A player can belong to any number of groups.
players_uid_copy_failed: Could not copy — select and copy it manually.
players_icon_search_placeholder: Search with a player card's name
players_remove_confirm: Stop managing {name}? Their past campaigns are kept — they simply become a frozen guest there. This can't be undone from here.
players_group_remove_confirm: Remove the play group {name}? The players in it are not affected — only the group is deleted. This can't be undone from here.
